use_cases: Primary call-to-action buttons in web applications with engaging hover feedback
Form submission buttons where visual feedback enhances user confidence
Navigation action buttons requiring immediate visual response to interaction
Landing page CTA buttons that draw attention through animation
ai_summary: A minimalist button component featuring a smooth corner-to-corner circular fill animation on hover, with integrated scale transitions and automatic color inversion for light/dark modes. The button uses CSS pseudo-elements for the fluid background transition effect, making it ideal for modern web interfaces requiring elegant micro-interactions.
